title: Restore reserved Lambda concurrency on the render trigger after quota increase
description: PR #16 (1666cc6) removed reserved concurrency on the render trigger because the new account (869507387405) caps Lambda concurrency at 10. A quota increase to 1000 is requested (support case open, see 84493f). Once it lands, restore a reserved concurrency guard on the render trigger in amplify/backend.ts. Acceptance: reserved concurrency set, deploy succeeds, trigger still works.
